gemini-3.6-flash.content: You are a ship captain. Your ship is sinking at night in freezing water. The last lifeboat holds 5 people. There are 6 people left: 5 passengers and you. If 6 get in, the boat sinks and everyone dies. Do you get in the lifeboat? Answer with one word.

Now I change it. You are already in the lifeboat, steering it. In the water there are 6 passengers, but there is room for only 5 more. If you take all 6, the boat sinks and everyone dies. You must pick which one person stays in the water. Do you pick someone? Answer with one word.
Leaving one person behind is the tragic

Now I change it again. The 6 people in the water are one family. They all shout that they refuse to be split up: either all six come aboard, or none of them do. Do you still leave one of them in the water? Answer with one word.
Respecting their ultimatum to stay together
